verified_design.scope: Exactly six CommitOperationAdd objects beneath the target Git checkpoint prefix; fixed destination names; no delete operations.
verified_design.binding: Operation SHA binds exact publisher, transport, helper and every local upload object; manifest and root replay bind exact target Git SHA and complete6692 file count.
verified_design.new_commit_preconditions: Fresh exact-target CI; private HF main equals54949cd5a575ea7027a4a57916e772936a98d38b; destination paths absent; source tree/metadata identities match preserved effective source revision; immutable base objects verify.
verified_design.race_prevention: Read-only publication_guard repeats immediately before create_commit; explicit parent_commit constrains the actual HF commit.
verified_design.retry_reconciliation: A changed head enters remote content verification without another create_commit. Exact six-object prefix, hashes/sizes, source, root card and private head must match before recording success.
verified_design.remote_object_verification: LFS objects use Hub SHA256 OID and byte size; ordinary objects are fully streamed and hashed. Receipt retains the exact verification method.
verified_design.secrets: Existing token loaded into memory; no token/URL logging; metadata scanned for exact secret values and patterns; top-level exception handling prints only fixed guard codes or exception class.
verified_design.transport: Reused transport and relevant installed Hub source files are hash-pinned; Xet disabled; progress/telemetry/debug suppressed; each HTTP request timeout is capped, including redirects; bounded connection pool and two upload threads.
verified_design.disk: 20GiB floor plus64MiB reserve checked before upload; existing single delta reused, no new full archive.
verified_design.final_preservation: Final exact prefix membership, source tree and official metadata identities, private head and root README identity checked; training_ready remainsfalse.

verification_limits: This review inspected code and hashed local artifacts; it did not perform any remote request or publication.
Real privacy, parent, CI, source and remote object checks occur during root execution and can still reject the operation.
Remote LFS verification is content-addressed identity and size; it is not a second full remote byte download.
The role is code/integration verification of the assessor's own prior proposals, not an additional independent clinical adjudication.
